question: How do I extend my residence card?
required_facts: Enrolled students apply from 4 months before the visa expiration date, no later than the expiration date, at the immigration office
Documents include application form, passport, ARC, certificate of enrollment, tuition receipt, transcript, proof of residence, fee KRW 60,000
Students on leave of absence must leave Korea within 30 days and return the RC, so they cannot extend while on leave

reference_answer: If you are enrolled, you apply for an extension of stay at the immigration office from 4 months before your visa expires until the expiry date, bringing the application form, passport, alien registration card, certificate of enrollment, tuition payment receipt, last semester's transcript, proof of residence and the KRW 60,000 fee; unpaid National Health Insurance counts against you. If you are on a leave of absence, you cannot extend: students on leave must leave Korea within 30 days and return the residence card at the airport, then get new visa documents when they re-register.
notes: academic_status is unstated and the gold persona is on leave, which flips the answer (extension needs a certificate of enrollment; leave students must leave Korea).
